title: eludite.editor.format_selection input
description: Format the selected lines (Edit > Advanced > Format Selection, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+F; brief 0069) with the language server's textDocument/rangeFormatting; with no selection, the caret's line. One undo step; the document is not saved.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
